objects.name: sv_m
objects.ddl: CREATE DATABASE `sv_m` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci */

objects.name: customers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'login, with ''quote'' and\nnewline',
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `score` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `full_name` varchar(200) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (concat(convert(`name` using utf8mb4),' ',`email`)) VIRTUAL,
  `status` enum('a','b','c') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_name` (`name`(10)),
  KEY `idx_created` (`created_at` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_score` CHECK (`score` >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci COMMENT='Customers'

objects.name: hist
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `hist` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `v` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci WITH SYSTEM VERSIONING

objects.name: item_tags
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `item_tags` (
  `item_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`,`tag`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tag_item` FOREIGN KEY (`item_id`) REFERENCES `items` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

objects.name: items
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `items` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

objects.name: legacy
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `legacy` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

objects.name: logs
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`at`))
(PARTITION `p2025` VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION `p2026` VALUES LESS THAN (2027) ENGINE = InnoDB)

objects.name: notes
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `notes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `body` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` char(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci

objects.name: orders
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `note` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_customer` (`customer_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

objects.name: v_orders
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `sv_m`.`v_orders` AS select `o`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`email` AS `email` from (`sv_m`.`orders` `o` join `sv_m`.`customers` `c` on(`c`.`id` = `o`.`customer_id`)) where `o`.`total` > 10

objects.name: seq_ids
objects.ddl: CREATE SEQUENCE `seq_ids` start with 100 minvalue 1 maxvalue 9223372036854775806 increment by 5 cache 1000 nocycle ENGINE=InnoDB

objects.name: p_touch
objects.ddl:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` PROCEDURE `p_touch`(IN cid INT)
BEGIN
  
  UPDATE customers SET name = 'x;y' WHERE id = cid;
END

objects.name: f_double
objects.ddl:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` FUNCTION `f_double`(x INT) RETURNS int(11)
    DETERMINISTIC
RETURN x * 2

objects.name: pkg_util
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER="root"@"%" PACKAGE "pkg_util" AS FUNCTION f1 RETURN INT; END

objects.name: pkg_util
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER="root"@"%" PACKAGE BODY "pkg_util" AS FUNCTION f1 RETURN INT AS BEGIN RETURN 1; END; END

objects.name: trg_bi
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER trg_bi BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.total = ROUND(NEW.total, 2)

objects.name: trg_bi2
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER trg_bi2 BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.note = COALESCE(NEW.note, '')

objects.name: ev_cleanup
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` EVENT `ev_cleanup` ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 DAY STARTS '2026-01-01 00:00:00' ON COMPLETION NOT PRESERVE DISABLE DO DELETE FROM logs WHERE at < '2000-01-01'
